messages:
devon: FYI — ran through onboarding with a customer using the CLI quickstart. first generate returned 200 during signup, after they completed billing the same app started getting 402s. UI showed "trial activated" then flipped. this one is weird because they never changed env vars.

leila: can you share the exact CLI steps and any local files the quickstart writes? could be token rotation vs local cache.

devon: steps:
```
redwood auth create-service-account --name quickstart-sa
# CLI prints a token and writes ~/.redwoodrc with 'token=sa-temp-xxx'
./run-quickstart
# first request -> 200 OK
# customer adds card in console
# later requests -> 402 Payment Required
```
response headers on fail: x-request-id:req_cli_01, x-auth-token-state:revoked, x-billing-state:suspended

marc: ah, we recently changed the onboarding flow to issue a short-lived provisional token while card verification is pending. once payment clears we rotate to a permanent SA token and revoke provisional. looks like the quickstart persists the provisional token to ~/.redwoodrc and doesn't re-check validity before subsequent requests.

leila: that matches. also older go/js SDKs would retry on 402 if they saw x-retry-after:0 combined with our generic retry policy, which can mask the immediate failure in some UIs. so two issues: (1) quickstart caches provisional token and doesn't detect rotation; (2) SDK retry policy can hide the 402.

devon: repro info: customer did not regenerate key — they relied on the CLI auto-write. workaround we advised: run `redwood auth refresh-service-account --id sa-...` after payment clears, or delete ~/.redwoodrc and re-run auth flow, then restart quickstart. that fixed it for them.

marc: plan: (a) quickstart change: detect token_state via a light /v1/auth/validate on startup and prompt to refresh if token is provisional/revoked (owner: leila, eta: 5 days), (b) CLI change: don't auto-persist provisional tokens to disk; write them to stdout with clear TTL and a hint to rotate (owner: marc, eta: 3 days), (c) SDK hotfix: treat 402 as terminal for non-idempotent endpoints and log when a 4xx was retried (owner: eng-infra, eta: 48h).

onboard-bot: created INF-6123: "CLI quickstart: provisional token persisted -> 402 after billing; SDK retries mask failure" assigned to marc. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6123

support: add to playbook: if a customer sees first-call success then 402, ask for ~/.redwoodrc presence, x-request-id, and whether they used CLI-generated token; recommend `redwood auth refresh-service-account` or delete cache + re-auth as immediate workaround.

devon: Customer confirmed workaround worked. i'll file a docs PR to note the provisional token TTL in the quickstart and link to the support KB. :white_check_mark:
